paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: This figure illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values across layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, as indicated by the title "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3." The X-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The Y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Three lines are displayed. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed style, represents "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003"; it remains nearly flat and close to 0.0 across all layers, starting around 0.01 at layer 0 and staying at or near 0.0 through layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted style, represents "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126"; it starts at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, decreases steeply through layers 0 to 5, continues to decline more gradually from around 0.15 at layer 5 to near 0.02–0.05 around layers 10–20, and shows a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at layer 23. The third line, shown in green with a dash-dot style, represents "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080"; it starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, decreases sharply to around 0.1 by layer 3–4, continues declining to near 0.0 by layer 7–8, and remains close to 0.0 through layer 23. The legend is located in the upper right area of the plot.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers of a model, using a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown. The first line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," is a blue dashed line that remains nearly flat and close to zero throughout, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and staying near 0.01 across all layers, ending near 0.005 at layer 23. The second line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," is an orange dotted line that starts at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, drops steeply through the early layers to about 0.15 at layer 5, continues decreasing more gradually to around 0.02–0.03 by layer 10, and then remains relatively low through layer 23, with a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at the final layer. The third line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," is a green dash-dot line that starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, decreases sharply to about 0.10 at layer 5, continues declining to near 0.01 by layer 8, and then remains close to zero for the remaining layers through layer 23.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output values that fall below a threshold of 1e-3, measured across different layers of a model. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown. The first line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," is blue with a dashed line style. It remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and staying near 0.01 through layer 23. The second line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," is orange with a dotted line style. It starts at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, decreases steeply to around 0.15 by layer 5, continues declining to approximately 0.03 by layer 10, and then remains relatively low with a slight increase toward the end, reaching approximately 0.05 at layer 23. The third line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," is green with a dash-dot line style. It starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, decreases steeply to around 0.08 by layer 5, and then falls to near 0.0 by approximately layer 8, remaining close to zero through layer 23.
model_annotations.German: This figure shows the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output values that fall below a threshold of 1e-3, plotted across transformer layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are displayed. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed style, represents "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003"; it remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and staying near 0.01 throughout, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted style, represents "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126"; it starts at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, decreases steeply through the first few layers to about 0.15 by layer 5, continues declining more gradually to around 0.02 by layer 12, and then remains near 0.02–0.05 through layer 23, with a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at the final layer. The third line, shown in green with a dash-dot style, represents "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080"; it starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, drops sharply to about 0.10 by layer 5, continues decreasing to near 0.0 by layer 8, and remains approximately at 0.0 through the remaining layers up to layer 23.
